_about: Alt text for news pictures drawn by site/illustrate_news.py, keyed by news id. Used by site/build.py.
first-bacterium-had-a-full-flagellum: Illustration: a rod-shaped cell in shallow water with a long wavy tail and ringed motor at its base, above layered rock.
a-mirror-image-letter-stops-rna-copying: Illustration: a primer strand copying along a template stops at one flipped, rust-coloured letter, with the next letter waiting unused.
comets-probably-did-not-deliver-cyanide: Illustration: a comet breaking into fragments as it falls toward a wide sea with only a small island of land.
polymerase-ribozyme-copies-at-94-percent: Illustration: a small RNA hairpin beside a long chain of copied beads, one bead in rust marking an error.
side-reactions-need-not-doom-cycles: Illustration: a ring of four molecules forms a cycle; a branch leads to a side product and a teal line leads back into the cycle.
lifeless-protocells-pass-microfossil-tes: Illustration: spheres, threads and a lens shape embedded in layered rock, like microfossils.
impact-model-dates-the-rna-world-window: Illustration: impactors falling through the sky onto cratered rock, with a small RNA hairpin in the water between them.
rethinking-alkaline-vents: Illustration: two short vent chimneys on the seafloor under faint, nearly flat lines suggesting a weak gradient.
first-structures-of-polymerase-ribozymes: Illustration: a curved RNA shape wraps like a hand around a double strand and one incoming letter.
archaeal-ancestor-was-a-methanogen: Illustration: a branching tree rooted in rock, with bubbles of gas rising from its base.
assembly-index-from-flight-mass-spectra: Illustration: a mass spectrum of vertical peaks above layered rock, with a teal line sloping across the peaks.
luca-enzyme-set-was-incomplete: Illustration: a grid of pale tiles with several gaps filled by rust-coloured metal diamonds.
volcanic-rocks-supply-phosphite: Illustration: a volcano beside a shallow lake holding small pale triangles for dissolved phosphorus.
first-sugar-in-interstellar-space: Illustration: a faint gas cloud holding a four-bead chain, with a radio dish on the rock below pointing at it.
noisy-genome-training-reads-ancestral-tr: Illustration: a tree whose branch tips carry columns of beads, some of them missing or faded.
vent-walls-pass-electrons-not-ions: Illustration: a thick mineral wall in shallow water with four straight arrows running through it, while round ions queue on one side and one sits stuck inside the wall.
